coverage.note: Phase 3 holder snapshot compared with Phase 2 supply snapshot.

lp_status.note: LP mint supply is zero or effectively all observed LP supply is held by configured burn address(es).

liquidity_mapping.note: LP candidates are not excluded from adjusted concentration. For concentrated-liquidity venues without a fungible LP mint, lock state may remain UNKNOWN until a verified position decoder is added.

notes: Raw includes every discovered non-zero holder.
Adjusted excludes only confirmed LIQUIDITY_POOL and BURN.
LP_CANDIDATE, PROGRAM, PROGRAM_CONTROLLED, UNKNOWN remain included.

adjusted_confirmed_normal_metadata.interpretation: Adjusted view excludes only explicitly confirmed non-holder classifications; unresolved/program-controlled classes remain included and must not be described as pure normal-holder concentration.
